findings.text: non-blocking: _round_has_delivered re-implements a capability the repository already owns at reckon/sprint_liveness.py:115 (_manifest_status reads the status line off a record's manifest_path with the bounded regex ^status:\s*(\S+), and reckon/crew/admission/readiness.py:434 owns the parse_manifest route that reads a JSON body), so this is a third copy of one read; it duplicates the read the owner performs and only shares the vocabulary through manifest_status_is_terminal, and a manifest whose body is JSON reads as not delivered, which is the vanished-duty shape 2b9aef2217 set out to repair. Sampled 60 recent manifests under ~/.config/reckon/crew/runs/*/manifest.md: 0 are JSON bodies, so the practical exposure today is small.

non-blocking: the delivered-round rule added in 2b9aef2217 has no test. _write_working_review (line 92) and _write_working_repair (line 126) write no manifest_path on their round pointers, so _round_has_delivered returns False in every recorded case and the branch that counts a round whose manifest reached a terminal status has no assertion that would redden if it were removed or inverted; the fragment's claim that a delivered round stays counted rests on the caller-file arm observed once, not on a test.

non-blocking: the per-row snapshot fallback makes a caller outside _closure_rows pay the whole exclusion once per row. promotion_release.py:1043 counts pointer by pointer through _drain_row, so a fleet reading over N live pointers lists the pointer directory N times and re-reads every review or repair round's manifest N times, where drain and drain_unreconciled_by_session now read once; 2b9aef2217 published the snapshot only through _closure_rows, so only the drain path received the fix.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from 01f870fb7f to 91e6c988a6: ac5790768f moves the exclusion into _drain_row behind two context variables, 2b9aef2217 adds the one-snapshot publish and _round_has_delivered, 91e6c988a6 updates the fragment and cites the arm figures; 166 insertions across three declared files.
item_verdicts.done_when: §53 asks that three subject runs read a count of 1 naming the delivered run with no review; tests/test_the_unreconciled_count_leaves_out_runs_whose_own_review_is_i.py:101-106 asserts the count, the run-id list and the session summary, and gate4-head.log records 55 passed EXIT=0 for it.
item_verdicts.goal: the source node's goal is that the unreconciled count leaves out runs whose own review or repair is in flight; the gained commits keep that and move the decision into reckon/crew/runs.py:2557-2560 so the drain, the session drain (runs.py:3013), the published snapshot and promotion_release.py:1043 count through one composition.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reports status complete, records the declared arms (55 passed head, 51 passed base), the two caller-file arms with identical failing-id sets, two negative controls, and baseline_suite/after_suite JSON both completed with zero failures.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the reviewed manifest declares reckon/crew/runs.py, tests/test_the_unreconciled_count_leaves_out_runs_whose_own_review_is_i.py and the evidence fragment; git diff --stat over 01f870fb..91e6c988 names those three files and nothing else.

justifications.durability: tests/test_the_unreconciled_count_leaves_out_runs_whose_own_review_is_i.py:216-217 is backed by a recorded control that reddens it when runs.py is reverted to 01f870fb, and the queued case at :172-177 would redden if the queued filter at runs.py:2896 were dropped, but _round_has_delivered has no assertion because the round fixtures at :92 and :126 carry no manifest_path.
justifications.evidence: gate4-head.log reads 55 passed EXIT=0 at 2b9aef2217, gate3-base.log 51 passed EXIT=0 at af288e1, and the two caller-file arms read 68 failed / 737 passed and 68 failed / 741 passed with byte-identical FAILED id sets; the fragment's head job id 1313699 is not written by any log on disk (gate4-job.log carries only GATE4_DONE) though it does appear in the run's harness transcript, and no arm measures the delivered-round branch.
justifications.fit: the added helpers follow the module's local-import, Mapping-typed idiom beside the ContextVar already at reckon/crew/runs.py:1160, and their docstrings state the mechanism with no plan, ticket or stage label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/runs.py:2557-2560 excuses the in-flight subject and its working round for every caller of _drain_row, which both drain entry points (runs.py:2971, runs.py:3013) and promotion_release.py:1043 reach, so the count no longer diverges between readings.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/runs.py:2855 duplicates the manifest-status read the repository owns at reckon/sprint_liveness.py:115 rather than extending it, while the exclusion itself now correctly extends the single row composition at reckon/crew/runs.py:2521.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff --stat 01f870fb..91e6c988 is one of the three declared write paths, and the fragment's edit carries only the figures and the composition account.
